description: Utility class providing methods for XML parsing, transformation, and handling within the OFBiz framework, including DOM manipulation, XML validation, and custom entity resolution.

classes.name: UtilXml
classes.description: Final utility class for XML processing, including parsing, serialization, DOM manipulation, and custom entity resolution.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalResolver
classes.description: Handles local entity resolution for DTDs and schemas, avoiding external network calls during XML validation.

classes.name: UtilXml.LocalErrorHandler
classes.description: Handles SAX parsing errors, warnings, and fatal errors, especially in relation to DTD validation.

methods.name: getDomLsImplementation
methods.description: Returns a DOMImplementationLS instance for DOM Level 3 Load and Save operations.

methods.name: createXStream
methods.description: Initializes and returns an XStream instance for object serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: writeXmlDocument
methods.description: Serializes a DOM Node to an OutputStream with specified formatting options.

methods.name: readXmlDocument
methods.description: Parses XML content from various sources into a Document object, with optional validation and position tracking.

methods.name: makeEmptyXmlDocument
methods.description: Creates a new empty XML Document, optionally with a specified root element.

methods.name: addChildElement
methods.description: Creates and appends a child element to a parent element.

methods.name: addChildElementValue
methods.description: Creates a child element with a text value and appends it to a parent element.

methods.name: childElementList
methods.description: Returns a list of child elements, optionally filtered by name or set of names.

methods.name: elementValue
methods.description: Retrieves the concatenated text content of an element.

methods.name: getNodeNameIgnorePrefix
methods.description: Returns the node name without namespace prefix.

methods.name: createApacheLicenceComment
methods.description: Creates a Comment node containing the Apache License header.
